s.note: Kamala's family home in Jersey City
s.how: Boil and crush 600g potatoes with 150g peas, fried onion and a spoon of garam masala. Cut spring roll pastry into strips, fill and fold into triangles. Fry at 180C until crisp. Blend mint into Greek yoghurt for a cool dipping sauce.

Heat a splash of oil in a large lidded pot and pop 100g popping corn. Melt 60g butter with lime zest and a pinch of chilli flakes and toss through. Squeeze over a little lime juice and serve in silver bowls like a snack on a space station.

m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in yoghurt and garam masala for 2 hours. Fry 2 sliced onions until crisp. Par-cook 400g basmati for 5 minutes. Layer chicken, rice and onions in a pot, drizzle with saffron soaked in milk, seal tightly and bake at 170C for 45 minutes.

w.note: Kamala's fan art of Captain Marvel
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, then 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 175C for 18 minutes and cool. Pipe swirls of red, blue and gold buttercream on top and finish each with a little star.

d.how: Blend the flesh of 2 ripe mangoes with 300g Greek yoghurt, 250ml cold milk, a spoon of sugar and a pinch of ground cardamom until smooth. Pour over ice in tall glasses. Thick, cold and good for a family movie night.
